LinkedIn CEOs and startup founders are apparently discovering something revolutionary:

Having friends.

Taking the bus.

Going on dates with your wife.

Spending time with your family.

Having a baby.

The problem is they can’t experience any of these things without immediately turning them into a corporate framework, leadership lesson, quarterly review or LinkedIn post.

In this video, we’re looking at some of the strangest examples of corporate culture completely consuming people’s personal lives.
